en: A vintage multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard with five images related to Countess von Cosel and Stolpen Castle. The central image shows a hilltop town with a fortified complex above surrounding fields. Other images depict a portrait of Gräfin v. Cosel, the Coselturm tower of the castle, an ornate model of her travelling coach, and an interior salon furnished in historical style. Gothic script in the center reads "Burgstadt Stolpen i. Sa." with caption labels under each smaller image.
